summary: Add wake-summary builders so PR babysit watch can act on deltas without reloading full PR state (#1080).
migration_impact: No downstream repo migration. Watch integration lands in a follow-up PR; this release only adds the pure summary module and agent wiki guidance.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the release containing #1080 ships.
2. On wake, prefer build_wake_summary/render_wake_summary over full GraphQL PR reload unless merge conflict or missing detail requires it.
3. Read docs/wiki/PR-Babysit-Wake-Summary.md for agent operating rules.
agent_notes: On babysit watch wake, call build_wake_summary with REST deltas and prev/cur snapshots. Act on render_wake_summary output when is_actionable is true. Do not poll _load_pr_data every tick; reload full PR state only when the summary indicates merge conflict or insufficient detail.
